sources.snippet: Choose BidirLM-Omni for proven multilingual performance across 119 languages; choose Jina if you prioritize model size and inference speed and can tolerate reduced multilingual coverage. Both target similar use cases, but Jina emphasizes efficiency while BidirLM-Omni emphasizes breadth.
